title: Blast reported at Saudi Arabia's Riyadh airport
summary: Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport has already been targeted multiple times this week amid intensified fighting between Yemen-based Houthi rebels and a Saudi-backed coalition.

image.caption: Major airlines have suspended operations in Riyadh amid security threats [FILE: JANUARY 2020]Image: Amr Nabil/AP/picture alliance

blocks.text: King Khalid International Airport in the Saudi capital Riyadh was evacuated Saturday after a blast was reported, witnesses and local officials told several news agencies.
There were no immediate reports of possible damage or injuries, and Saudi officials have not issued a statement.
AFP news news agency reported a witness hearing an explosion while waiting to board a flight.
Strikes hit Riyadh airport earlier this week
The reports come amid intensified fighting between Houthi rebels and the Saudi-backed government in Yemen.

The Iran-backed Houthis have been launching strikes on targets in Saudi Arabia, including several this week on the airport in Riyadh that killed four people, injured several others, and damaged planes.
Etihad Airways and Qatar Airways canceled multiple flights between their ​respective hubs and Riyadh, with some cancellations extending into Monday.

blocks.caption: King Khalid Airport was hit earlier this week in an attack claimed by Yemen-based Houthi rebels Image: Social Media/REUTERS

blocks.text: There was no immediate Houthi statement about the reported blast on Saturday.

Last month, Houthi rebels made advances on important strategic locations along Yemen's Red Sea coast, with a Saudi-led coalition providing air support for Yemeni government forces seeking to take back those gains.

The Houthis have responded by launching attacks into Saudi Arabia, which represents a significant escalation in their multi-year conflict with Yemen's Riyadh-backed government after a peace deal unraveled in July.
The Saudi-backed government in Yemen last week announced a counter-offensive aimed at retaking all areas held by the Houthis, especially those around the Bab al-Mandab strait.
